program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id (weak inversion -> max gm per uA)
    "L1":    (0.18, 0.15, 1.0),      # diff pair L
    "Itail": (5e-6, 2e-6, 9e-6),     # preamp tail current
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror-load & CS-PMOS gm/Id (same -> balanced DC level)
    "Lp":    (0.25, 0.15, 1.0),      # PMOS L (short -> low preamp gain, fast recovery)
    "I2":    (5e-6, 2e-6, 9e-6),     # CS stage current
    "gmidb": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # NMOS bias mirrors gm/Id
    "Lb":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L
    "Wbuf":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),       # output inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2.5x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-14)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]

    # bias mirrors (same gm/Id and L as the ibias diode)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], It, vds=0.35)
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # preamp
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.35)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=1.0)        # diode / mirror load
    # CS PMOS: same gm/Id & L as load -> o1 balance equals diode node voltage
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side (4 inversions overall -> vout high when vinp>vinn)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    # inverter 1 (minimum, low load on o2)
    n.M("M7", "o3", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 0.15)
    n.M("M8", "o3", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 1.0, 0.15)
    # inverter 2 drives CL
    wn = p["Wbuf"]
    n.M("M9", "vout", "o3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn, 0.15)
    n.M("M10", "vout", "o3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.5 * wn, 0.15)

    # first-order predictions
    cox = 8.5e-15  # F/um^2 approx
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    C1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + 2 * m5.cgd + 0.3e-15
    wT1 = gm1 / C1
    t1 = (A1 / wT1) * math.log(2) + C1 * 0.1 / max(gm1 * vod, 1e-9)
    C2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + (0.42 + 1.0) * 0.15 * cox + 0.6e-15
    t2 = C2 * (vdd / 2) / I2
    C3 = 3.5 * wn * 0.15 * cox + 0.5e-15
    t3 = C3 * 0.9 / 150e-6 + cl * 0.9 / (300e-6 * wn)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "A1": A1, "wT1": wT1, "t1": t1, "t2": t2, "t3": t3}
